lina-qa: RC ready for promotion — rc-20260320-7a9f
author: lina-qa

Build pinned to sha256:7a9f8b3c. Change window today 21:00-22:00 UTC.
Smoke tests in CI passed (all suites), e2e flaky test skipped with note. Requesting sign-off from SRE/ENG/PM for canary plan. Release notes drafted.

deploy-bot: rc created: rc-20260320-7a9f · artifact pinned
To promote: /promote rc-20260320-7a9f prod --canary 5
CI: artifact verified, image scan: no critical vulns

james-eng: LGTM from eng. Verified migration script no-ops, no schema changes. Will watch the rollout.

eva-sre: I'll be oncall during the window. Staging load test: 200rps sustained, error rate <0.1%.
Rollback plan: revert to rc-20260318-3b2c via pin + traffic-shift script. Steps in playbook:
1) pin previous RC
2) shift canary -> 0
3) run health-checks
I'll set an alert: errors >1% OR latency p95 > 2x baseline.

marta-release: Release notes: small bugfix (tokenization edge case), batching defaults tweak, no API contract changes. I'll publish notes + changelog after promo. :memo:

oliver-pm: Approve. Suggest starting at 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full if no regressions. Notify support and CS before full roll.

lina-qa: Plan acked. Final plan:
- Canary 5% for 10m
- Increase to 25% for 20m
- Full 100% after additional 30m if metrics stable
Monitors: p95 latency, 200ms bucket counts, error rate, token cost delta. Pager thresholds as eva listed.
Tagging: @eva-sre @james-eng @marta-release @oliver-pm

james-eng: ACK. I'll keep a hotfix branch ready and be on slack for immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by lina-qa for 2026-03-20T21:00:00Z (/promote queued)
Command queued:
```
/promote rc-20260320-7a9f prod --canary 5 --notes "rc-20260320: tokenization bugfix"
```
Will post status updates to thread. :rocket:

lina-qa: Thanks — will post final post-mortem check after rollout. If anything goes weird, run rollback plan and ping here."
